Subject: Pen test re-test request and formal validation letter

Hi Lauren / Rafael,

Thanks for the remediation summary you sent last week. Acme completed an internal review of the proposed fixes and our security team has two asks before we close the control:

1) A re-test (delta test) from your third-party vendor that verifies the items listed in the remediation matrix (IDs 3, 5, 7).
2) A short signed validation letter from Redwood stating the scope of the re-test and that the reported issues were remediated and verified.

Can you confirm whether Cybersafe (or another vendor) can run the delta re-test and provide the delta report + signed validation letter? We are working to meet our audit committee deadline of Dec 15. If you can provide a target date for the re-test and the expected artifacts, that would be helpful.

For context, the original pen test report reference: ACME-PT-202605 (we already shared that with your team).

Appreciate a quick timeline so we can plan our internal acceptance testing.

Best,
Jane Carter
Director, Information Security
Acme Corporation

Thanks Jane — looping in Mina (security) and Jonas (legal) to coordinate.

Mina / Rafael — quick plan proposal:
- Ask Cybersafe to execute a targeted delta re-test covering IDs 3,5,7 from ACME-PT-202605 (confirm scope: authenticated endpoints + session handling).
- Request from Cybersafe: a delta findings report (PDF) plus a signed validation letter on company letterhead that states the re-test scope, test dates, and that the specified findings were verified as remediated.
- Target timeline: execute re-test week of Dec 7, deliverables by Dec 10 to meet Acme audit window.

Mina: can you confirm that the remediation steps we applied are sufficient and that we can commit to that schedule? Rafael: please coordinate procurement/PO with Cybersafe if we go that route. Jonas: we may need a short attestation (non-legal) from Redwood to include in Acme's package; is language pre-approved or should we route through legal review?

Jane — we'll confirm by EOD today whether Cybersafe can run the delta and we'll follow up with a concrete date.
